svg.text: Block Merkle Tree — Chaining, Structure, and Item Hashing
All 16 Mountain Top positions are always fed into the tree; positions 9–16 use hash(0x00) until assigned.
Positions 1–8 — always real content, or hash(0x00) if this block has none
Positions 9–16 — always hash(0x00) until a future spec version assigns them
How a streaming sub-tree is actually built (Input Items Root example):
Consensus Headers, Output Items, and State Changes roots are built the same way, from their own item types.
This 3-item tree leans left: Tx 3 attaches
directly to the root instead of pairing with
a fourth, padded leaf. The incremental
valid root for any item count without ever
needing a null or empty-byte placeholder leaf.
